title_en: Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening Cultural Construction in People's Courts under the New Situation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Cultural Construction of People's Courts under the New Situation

Fa Fa [2015] No. 15

Since 2010, people's courts at all levels across the country have earnestly implemented the overall部署 of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on socialist cultural construction, and in accordance with the requirements of the Supreme People's Court's "Opinions on Further Strengthening the Cultural Construction of People's Courts," have vigorously promoted court cultural construction, achieving remarkable results and promoting the scientific development of the work of people's courts. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, focusing on the grand goals of realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and building a socialist cultural power, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China has made a series of new部署 and requirements for cultural construction. General Secretary Xi Jinping has made a series of important expositions on cultural construction. The Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China have all put forward clear requirements for cultural construction. Based on the new spirit and new requirements of the Central Committee on cultural construction, combined with the new situation and new tasks facing the people's courts, the following guiding opinions are hereby put forward for further strengthening the cultural construction of people's courts.

I. Overall Thinking and Principles and Requirements for Strengthening Court Cultural Construction

(1) Correctly understand the current situation of court cultural construction. At present, the "Four Comprehensives" strategic layout, especially the comprehensive advancement of the rule of law, is being deepened. People's courts are in a critical period of development and reform. The tasks of handling cases according to law and judicial reform are arduous and heavy. The construction of the court contingent faces many new situations and new problems. The ideological struggle in the judicial field is complex, making it even more necessary for court culture to provide ideological guidance, spiritual encouragement, and cultural nourishment. Through the joint efforts of courts at all levels across the country, the working mechanism for court cultural construction has gradually been improved, cultural positions and infrastructure have gradually been perfected, cultural activities and carriers have been continuously enriched, and many excellent achievements and valuable experiences have been formed. It has moved from a spontaneous stage to a conscious stage, laying a good foundation for development to a higher level. At the same time, there are also problems in court cultural construction, such as unclear functional positioning, insufficient connection with trial work, insufficient role of the main body of cadres and police, relatively weak literary and artistic creation of courts, relatively lagging application of information technology, weak communication power and influence facing society, and inadequate service for the national construction of the rule of law. To meet the situation and task requirements of comprehensively governing the country according to law and the development and reform of people's courts, it is necessary to deepen and expand the achievements achieved, strengthen and improve weak links, and further promote the in-depth development of court cultural construction.

(2) Overall thinking for strengthening court cultural construction. Hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, take Deng Xiaoping Theory, the important thought of "Three Represents," and the Scientific Outlook on Development as guidance, deeply study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important speeches, adhere to the forward direction of advanced socialist culture, take the core socialist values and the socialist rule of law concept as the guide, take justice for the people and fair justice as the soul and main line, take serving trials, serving cadres and police, and serving the construction of the rule of law as the goal, take cultivating the belief in the rule of law and promoting the spirit of the rule of law as the core, adhere to the development concepts of innovation, coordination, green, openness, and sharing, comprehensively and deeply promote court cultural construction, realize the coordinated development of the internal functions and external functions of court culture, and provide a strong value guiding force, cultural cohesion, and spiritual impetus for the development and reform of people's courts and the comprehensive promotion of the rule of law.

(3) Principles and requirements for strengthening court cultural construction.

- Adhere to the dominant position of cadres and police. Establish a cultural concept centered on cadres and police, adhere to cultural construction for cadres and police, rely on cadres and police, accurately grasp the spiritual and cultural needs of cadres and police, encourage full participation of cadres and police, enhance the cultural consciousness of cadres and police, make cultural construction conform to the wishes of cadres and police, reflect the wisdom of cadres and police, promote the comprehensive development of cadres and police, and enable cadres and police to have a greater sense of gain in cultural construction.

- Strengthen the function of guidance and motivation. Focus on educating people with culture, casting the soul with culture, adhere to arming people with scientific theory, shaping people with noble spirit, guiding people with correct public opinion, inspiring people with excellent works, and make efforts in firming ideals and beliefs, firming the belief in the rule of law, strengthening the spirit of the rule of law, and shaping noble personality, and consciously resist the influence of various wrong ideological trends and viewpoints.

- Pay attention to penetration, combination, and integration. Infiltrate cultural construction into all aspects of court work, organically combine and integrate with case handling, trial management, contingent construction, party construction in organs, and clean government construction, and reflect the effectiveness of cultural construction in improving the quality of the contingent, improving trial quality, and enhancing judicial credibility.

- Co-construction and sharing inside and outside the court. Adhere to the concept of openness in developing court culture, enhance the awareness of "inviting in" and "going out," seek guidance and support from cultural competent departments, leverage social cultural resources to improve the level of court cultural construction, rely on mass media and public cultural service platforms to enhance the communication power and influence of court culture facing society, and serve the national construction of the rule of law.

II. Cultivate and Promote Core Socialist Values

(4) Deepen the publicity and education of core values. Comprehensively and accurately grasp the basic connotation and practical requirements of core socialist values, conduct scientific interpretation and explanation in light of court reality, and enhance cadres' and police's understanding and recognition of core socialist values. The layout of the court cultural environment and the conduct of court cultural activities should highlight the ideological connotation of core socialist values, form a clear orientation and a strong atmosphere, and guide the majority of cadres and police to consciously become disseminators, leaders, and practitioners of core socialist values. Use court system media and social media, combined with trial work practice, to vigorously disseminate core socialist values, achieving full media publicity, full column integration, and full coverage. Promote the normalization of the theme education of "promoting justice through openness, building core values," and continuously deepen the education of core values.

(5) Strengthen the cultivation and formation of core values. Vigorously promote the national spirit with patriotism at its core and the spirit of the times with reform and opening up at its core. Combining major festivals and major theme activities, organize solemn ceremonies and educational court cultural activities. Standardize and popularize the activities of singing the national anthem and raising the national flag, and enhance cadres' and police's national consciousness and patriotic feelings. Closely combine court cultural activities with party history and national conditions education, revolutionary tradition education, and situation and policy education, and guide cadres and police to firm their ideals and beliefs. Deepen the education of the fine traditions of people's justice, cultivate and inherit fine court practices and court mottos. Extensively carry out mass spiritual civilization creation activities, and promote courts at all levels to strive for civilized units. Organize cadres and police to participate in Lei Feng-style volunteer service, promote the volunteer spirit of dedication, fraternity, mutual assistance, and progress, and carry out activities to strive for "Youth Civilization Numbers." Promote the excellent traditional Chinese culture, absorb and learn from local characteristic cultures, promote moral lecture hall activities, and strengthen the moral education of cadres and police. Publicize and commend outstanding cadres and police with high moral character, and recommend them to participate in the selection of moral models in various places.

(6) Give play to the trial function to promote the construction of core values. Earnestly implement the "Several Opinions on Cultivating and Practicing Core Socialist Values in the Work of People's Courts," and give full play to the role of judicial judgments in regulating, guiding, evaluating, and leading social values. Adhere to strict and fair justice, distinguish right from wrong, punish evil and promote good, truly ensure that behaviors conforming to core socialist values are protected, and behaviors violating core socialist values are sanctioned. Give full play to the important role of mediation, conciliation, and coordination in resolving disputes, promote the excellent traditional culture of advocating benevolence, emphasizing the people, abiding by integrity, upholding justice, advocating harmony, and seeking common ground, and create a friendly and harmonious social atmosphere. Encourage integrity and sanction dishonesty through judicial judgments, guide people to consciously fulfill legal obligations and social responsibilities, and promote the construction of the social credit system.

III. Give Play to the Functions of Court Culture to Promote Justice for the People and Fair Justice

(7) Firm cadres' and police's belief in the rule of law. Use court culture to guide cadres' and police's value pursuits, and strengthen the professional ideal of believing in the rule of law and adhering to the rule of law. Adopt multiple cultural forms and carriers, guide cadres and police to strengthen their high recognition of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, strengthen their persistent pursuit of fairness and justice, strengthen their firm adherence to the principles of the rule of law, strengthen their loyalty and love for the judicial cause, correctly understand and actively support judicial reform, and strive to strive for building a socialist country under the rule of law with Chinese characteristics. Formulate implementation measures for the people's courts to implement the constitutional oath system, and carefully organize and implement constitutional oaths. Clarify the requirements for the layout of the court cultural environment, highlight the core socialist values, the socialist rule of law concept, the work objectives and work themes of the people's courts, and the oath of the constitutional oath. Improve the method for issuing the "Balance Medal," and give full play to the incentive role of professional honor. Strengthen the publicity and commendation of advanced models, deeply carry out learning activities from advanced models such as Zou Bihua, and promote the noble spirit of advanced models who believe in the rule of law and adhere to the rule of law.

(8) Strengthen the professional ethics of cadres and police. Use court culture to improve the professional ethics of cadres and police, and establish the image of judges who are upright, enforce the law like a mountain, and are fair and clean. Deeply carry out education on judges' professional ethics and judicial conscience, guide the majority of judges to insist on taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, strictly administer justice, administer justice impartially, be impartial, neither wrong nor lenient, and strive to let the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case. Deeply carry out publicity and education on the norms of judges' conduct and the judicial responsibility system of the people's courts, clarify behavioral norms and power boundaries, and strengthen the consciousness of cadres and police to perform their duties according to law and regulations. Formulate judicial etiquette procedures and civilized language norms in light of local conditions, carry out judicial etiquette training and daily inspections, and strengthen the daily cultivation of civilized justice. Deeply publicize and earnestly implement the two provisions on recording and holding accountable leaders and internal personnel of judicial organs who interfere in judicial proceedings and inquire about cases, forming a cultural ecology that supports judges in adhering to principles and administering justice impartially.

(9) Enhance the judicial capacity of cadres and police. Earnestly carry out study and training on new laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, and organize cadres and police to strengthen the study of legal provisions and judicial cases. Focus on key, difficult, and hot issues in trial work, hold judge forums, judge salons, and judicial lecture halls, and conduct in-depth discussions and exchanges. Carry out selections of model trials, high-quality cases, and excellent judgment documents, motivate cadres and police to improve their trial business capabilities, and make the trial process and judgment documents important carriers for reflecting and disseminating court culture. Give full play to the role of organizations such as the China Trial Theory Research Society, the "Belt and Road" Judicial Research Center, and the Chinese Judicial Research Society, and strengthen research on applied legal theory, professional trial theory, and judicial culture. Courts at all levels should, based on trial practice, determine research content and organize topic research according to local conditions. Strengthen cooperation between courts at all levels and higher education institutions, provide more opportunities for cadres and police to study and further their education, and invite legal experts to lecture on frontier legal knowledge. Further improve the quality of trial business publications, to better summarize trial experience and exchange research results. Organize the publication of bilingual judge training textbooks and legal dictionaries for ethnic minorities, to meet the study and training needs of bilingual judges.

(10) Promote clean and honest justice among cadres and police. Earnestly carry out publicity and education on the Communist Party of China's integrity self-discipline code, disciplinary punishment regulations, and the people's courts' clean government system provisions, deeply advance the creation of clean government cultural activities, guide cadres and police to establish clean and honest values, and adhere to the bottom line of clean and honest justice. Adhere to the annual concentrated education activities on clean and honest justice, and use negative typical cases to strengthen warning education. Create clean government web pages on the internal court network, open clean government SMS platforms, and use knowledge contests, theme essay solicitations, maxim collections, thematic exhibitions, and other forms to carry out clean government cultural activities, forming a cultural atmosphere where integrity is honored and corruption is shameful. Carry out activities of family assistance for clean government and family affection promoting clean government, and enhance the awareness and ability of cadres and police to resist corruption and prevent degeneration.

IV. Give Play to the Functions of Court Culture to Promote the Comprehensive Development of Cadres and Police

(11) Create a strong learning atmosphere. Vigorously advocate the concept of lifelong learning and full participation learning, and deeply advance the activities of creating learning-oriented courts and learning-oriented party organizations. Strengthen the construction of libraries and reading rooms at all levels of courts, scientifically equip books and periodicals according to trial work needs and cadres' and police's learning needs, enhance digital service capabilities, and further improve service efficiency. Where conditions permit, seek support from cultural competent departments, coordinate public libraries to set up branches or circulation points in courts, and use the public cultural service system to serve cadres' and police's learning needs. Court libraries in ethnic minority areas should be equipped with legal books in minority languages. Extensively carry out activities such as president-recommended books, thematic reading, and reading exchanges, and deeply advance the full participation reading activities of court cadres and police. Organize cadres and police to build team learning platforms, and improve team learning mechanisms.

(12) Enrich the spiritual life of cadres and police. Based on the needs of cadres and police, establish amateur literary and artistic teams, strengthen work guidance, frequently carry out activities, and create conditions for cadres and police to improve their cultural and artistic cultivation. Combining major festivals, major events, and court establishment anniversaries, organize cultural activities welcomed by cadres and police, such as theatrical performances, singing competitions, themed speeches, and poetry recitals. Courts with conditions may hold themed cultural festivals to enhance the vitality and cohesion of the contingent. To meet the spiritual and cultural needs of cadres and police, carry out practical activities for cultural construction. Invite relevant experts to hold cultural and art lectures, organize cadres and police to watch excellent films and visit cultural and art exhibitions, and cultivate cadres' and police's ideological and emotional sentiments.

(13) Promote the physical and mental health of cadres and police. In light of court reality, carry out mass sports activities to promote cadres and police to strengthen their physique and maintain health. Improve indoor and outdoor sports and fitness venues, provide necessary service guarantees for cadres' and police's physical exercise, and hold sports meets, individual sports competitions, and other fitness activities as appropriate. Earnestly implement the system of physical examinations, vacations, and recuperation, establish health files for cadres and police, and carry out health intervention and health promotion activities. Strengthen mental health education for cadres and police. Courts with conditions may purchase social services and equip necessary equipment to provide mental health services for cadres and police. Adopt forms such as holding health lectures, pushing health information, and printing brochures to popularize health care, disease prevention, and first aid knowledge, and improve cadres' and police's health awareness and health care capabilities.

V. Give Play to the Functions of Court Culture to Serve the National Construction of the Rule of Law

(14) Strengthen judicial news publicity to enhance the rule of law awareness of the whole society. Promote the integrated development of traditional media and emerging media in the court system, realize the transformation and upgrading of news publishing units in the court system, and enhance the communication power, credibility, and influence of court media. Fully utilize various media inside and outside the court to actively publicize the judicial concepts, judicial policies, and trial practices of the people's courts, and disseminate the spirit of the rule of law and legal knowledge to society. Adhere to and improve the press release system, strengthen the publicity and interpretation of judicial interpretations and judicial policies, and timely release typical cases and the trial situation of socially concerned cases. Strengthen cooperation between courts at all levels and local news publicity departments, and promote the universal establishment of rule of law publicity columns in mainstream media at all levels. Extensively carry out theme activities such as "Constitution Day," "Court Open Day," and law into communities and villages. Compile and publish easy-to-understand rule of law publicity books, and organize the production of rule of law publicity public service advertisements. Earnestly implement the systems for legal research scholars and legal interns, allowing more law teachers and students to participate in the actual work of courts, enhancing their deep understanding and recognition of courts.

(15) Flourish and develop court literature and art, and sing the main theme of the construction of the rule of law. Earnestly study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Forum on Literature and Art Work and the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Flourishing and Developing Socialist Literature and Art," adhere to the people-centered creative orientation, make the Chinese spirit the soul of court literature and art, and strive to create excellent literary and artistic works that reflect the spirit of the times and the spirit of the rule of law. Pay attention to discovering and cultivating cultural talents from among cadres and police, and encourage cadres and police to create literary and artistic works based on trial practice. Give full play to the role of the Cultural Branch of the China Judges Association and the Film and Television Center of the Supreme People's Court, and promote court literary and artistic creation and cultural exchanges. Organize and implement the creation project of court literary and artistic works. Courts with conditions should strengthen cooperation with cultural competent departments and literary and artistic creation units, draw materials and refine themes from trial practice, and strive to create excellent works that unify ideology and artistry. Increase the dissemination and promotion of court-themed literary and artistic works, carry out classified national court excellent literary and artistic works selection and promotion activities, and promote their publication and broadcast in mainstream media, performance in public cultural venues, and dissemination on online platforms. The People's Court Press should actively plan relevant publication topics, and strive to produce high-quality court literary and artistic works.

(16) Promote the construction of cultural infrastructure, disseminate and promote the civilization of the rule of law. Focus on the public areas of courts at all levels, the litigation service centers, and the case filing halls, improve the construction of the court cultural environment and litigation service facilities, highlight the theme of justice for the people and fair justice, and make courts become cultural halls that embody and disseminate the civilization of the rule of law. Strengthen the cultural dissemination function of the National Judges College, and build it into a high-level training base for trial talents, a teaching and research base combining legal theory and practice research, a judicial case research base, and an international judicial exchange center. Build a world-class and leading Chinese Court Museum, and give full play to its functions as a rule of law education base, a judicial culture exchange base, a people's justice research base, and a Chinese judicial research base. Build a Hall of Fame of Chinese Legal Figures, to inherit and promote Chinese judicial civilization. Higher people's courts with conditions may build local court museums according to local conditions. Strengthen the construction of the national revolutionary tradition education bases for courts, enrich exhibition content, optimize exhibition forms, and enhance attractiveness and influence. Improve the content of court history exhibitions at all levels, and deeply explore the ideological and cultural connotations of important historical facts, important cases, major honors, and major models. Actively seek support from local competent departments, and use the former sites of judicial organs in different historical periods and the former residences of legal figures to build rule of law education bases with local characteristics.

VI. Improve the Informatization Level of Court Cultural Construction

(17) Promote the construction of court culture network platforms. Seize the favorable opportunity of building the people's court informatization 3.0 version, increase the intensity of building online court culture positions, and further promote the online dissemination of court culture. Rely on the internal network portal websites of the people's courts that connect the four levels of courts, explore the establishment of the Chinese Court Culture Network, and build a network platform for exchanging and sharing court cultural achievements nationwide. Improve the construction of internal networks and government affairs websites of courts at all levels, enhance the functions of rule of law publicity and cultural dissemination, and make them become cultural business cards for displaying court images and important platforms for disseminating the spirit of the rule of law. Open the English website of the Supreme People's Court, to disseminate the voice of Chinese courts to the international community and tell Chinese rule of law stories well. Further run the official microblogs, WeChat accounts of courts at all levels, and the Chinese Court Network, Chinese Court Mobile TV, and the "Chinese Rule of Law" client, fully utilize new media to enhance the communication power of court culture. Strengthen the management and guidance of court official microblogs, WeChat accounts, and WeChat public accounts of cadres and police, and prevent the dissemination of false information and inappropriate remarks.

(18) Using Online Platforms to Carry Out Cultural Work. Utilize network technology to innovate cultural work carriers, conducting activities such as knowledge contests, seminars and exchanges, online learning, surveys, psychological counseling services, and cultural talent displays through the court intranet. Optimize the "Court Culture" section of the intranet of courts at all levels, setting up columns for book recommendations, reading exchanges, film and television reviews, calligraphy and painting works, poetry and prose creation, etc., to enrich the cultural life of court personnel. Promote the distribution and dissemination of court-run publications on the intranet, digitize the content of court history museums, thematic exhibitions, publicity windows, legal education bases, and clean government education bases, and actively build online court history museums and online education bases. Establish a Court Heroes Hall on the website of the Supreme People's Court to centrally showcase the deeds and elegance of major model figures in the national court system, and set up advanced model exhibition halls and honor boards for outstanding court personnel on the websites of local courts.

(19) Relying on Online Platforms to Achieve Resource Sharing. Through platforms such as the China Judge Training Network and the China Court Cloud Classroom, gather and integrate high-quality resources for judge training for online learning and training by court personnel at all levels. Select high-quality local court-run publications and expand their dissemination scope through the China Court Culture Network, so that courts can learn from each other and court personnel everywhere can read them. Use the China Court Culture Network to centrally display various outstanding cultural works of courts nationwide, promote the dissemination of cultural works, and realize the sharing of cultural achievements. Give full play to the role of the National Library of China's Court Branch, actively promote the construction of digital libraries in courts at all levels, increase book capacity, improve service functions, and better meet the learning needs of court personnel.

VII. Strengthening Organizational Leadership over Court Culture Construction

(20) Persist in Placing Court Culture Construction in an Important Position. Party Leadership Groups of courts at all levels must firmly establish a sense of responsibility for cultivating people and rejuvenating the court through culture, place court culture construction on the important agenda, incorporate it into the overall planning of court work, conduct in-depth research on new situations, new characteristics, and problems faced, and strengthen organizational leadership and work guidance. In accordance with the requirements of comprehensively advancing the rule of law and the situation and tasks of the reform and development of the People's Courts, formulate and improve work plans for court culture construction, strengthen top-level design, and pay close attention to the implementation of work. Strengthen communication and coordination with local propaganda and cultural authorities, incorporate court culture construction into the overall pattern of local cultural construction, and actively seek work guidance and policy support. Include the funds for court culture construction in the annual budget, increase investment, and ensure actual needs.

(21) Construct a Work Pattern of Jointly Promoting Court Culture Construction. Establish and improve a working mechanism with unified leadership of the court Party Leadership Group, organization and coordination by political work departments, and joint participation of all court departments and directly affiliated units, forming a "big culture" work pattern. The Political Department (Division) of courts at all levels is responsible for the planning and deployment, supervision and guidance of court culture construction, and the organization and implementation of major activities. The Party Committee (General Party Branch) of the court organ takes the lead in organizing the cultural construction work of the court organ itself. Give full play to the functional roles and resource advantages of departments such as theoretical research, news publishing, education and training, disciplinary inspection and supervision, and information technology construction, strengthen overall coordination in planning and design, work implementation, supervision and guidance, and ensure policy and work articulation. Mass organizations such as the court trade union, Communist Youth League, Youth Federation, Women's Committee, and Judges Association shall cooperate actively in cultural construction work in light of their respective functions.

(22) Strengthen Guidance for Court Culture Construction Along the Line. Strengthen the guidance of higher-level courts over lower-level courts, improve assessment and incentive mechanisms, strengthen work exchanges, and promote the coordinated and overall advancement of court culture construction from top to bottom. Give full play to the role of national and provincial-level demonstration units for court culture construction, and promptly summarize and promote good experiences and practices. Select and promote national court culture construction brand projects. Each Higher People's Court shall formulate guiding standards for court culture construction that are suited to local realities, so as to promote the overall improvement of court culture construction levels. For intermediate and primary courts with weak cultural construction foundations and lagging development, higher-level courts shall strengthen supervision and guidance and provide necessary support. Organize research on court culture construction topics, explore and grasp the characteristics and patterns of the work, strive to form high-quality research results, and guide the in-depth development of court culture construction.

November 21, 2015
